comment: Advisories the CI npm audit steps accept (utilities/audit-check.js). Each entry needs a reason, and an expiry date after which it fails again so it gets looked at. Remove an entry once a fixed version is installed - the check warns when an entry no longer matches anything.

advisories.reason: ReDoS from crafted glob patterns; no fixed release (<=4.0.7, the latest). Shipped only via sqlite3 -> node-gyp -> tinyglobby, which runs at install time with node-gyp's own patterns; otherwise jest/typescript-eslint dev tooling. FHIRsmith never passes untrusted patterns to it.
